providers.name: Claude Code
providers.rollback: The setup command only prints Claude hook JSON; it does not change ~/.claude/settings.json. If you manually merged the generated hook entries there, remove only AgentTrace's commands while retaining other hooks.
providers.privacy: Events pass through AgentTrace's normal redaction path; hook visibility is limited to fields emitted by the provider.
known_gaps: File and command semantics depend on the tool payload exposed by Claude Code hooks.
This entry is intentionally marked unverified until a clean-environment versioned verification run is recorded.

providers.name: OpenAI Codex
providers.rollback: Setup preserves the original bytes once at hooks.json.agent-strace.bak next to $CODEX_HOME/hooks.json (default ~/.codex/hooks.json) before overwriting an existing file. Restore them with cp ~/.codex/hooks.json.agent-strace.bak ~/.codex/hooks.json, replacing ~/.codex with "$CODEX_HOME" when it is set. If no file existed before setup, remove the generated hooks.json from that directory instead.
providers.privacy: Events pass through AgentTrace's normal redaction path; hook visibility is limited to fields emitted by the provider.
known_gaps: The setup command replaces hooks.json rather than merging; repeated runs retain the first hooks.json.agent-strace.bak snapshot.
Codex runs command hooks only after they are reviewed and trusted in /hooks; codex exec skips untrusted hooks without a warning. Hooks added by a later setup run must be trusted again.
SessionEnd always reports reason "other", so the session_end event does not say why the session ended.

Subagents are not separate sessions: their hooks arrive under the parent session_id with an agent_id. SubagentStart and SubagentStop are recorded as subagent_start and subagent_stop events in the parent trace, and the subagent's tool events carry its agent_id and agent_type, but no event links a subagent to the spawn_agent call that started it.
A failed shell command arrives as a normal PostToolUse with the error text in tool_response, so it is recorded as a tool_result rather than an error.
Hook payloads carry the model name, recorded on the session_start event, but no token usage.
File and command detail depends on PreToolUse/PostToolUse payloads; shell calls arrive as tool_name Bash with tool_input.command.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
providers.rollback: Setup writes a dedicated file and leaves other Copilot hook files unchanged. Remove it with rm ~/.copilot/hooks/agent-strace.json, using $COPILOT_HOME/hooks/agent-strace.json when COPILOT_HOME is set. If you installed the agent-strace Copilot CLI plugin instead, run copilot plugin uninstall agent-strace.
providers.privacy: Events pass through AgentTrace's normal redaction path; hook visibility is limited to fields emitted by the provider.
known_gaps: Copilot can fire userPromptSubmitted before sessionStart, so a main session's trace may begin with its first user_prompt event. 1.0.94-3 always did; 1.0.103-0 did in some runs and fired sessionStart first in others.

Subagents started with the task tool record prompt, tool and stop events under their own session id with no session_start and no session_end. The parent's subagentStop hook (and, in some 1.0.103-0 runs, subagentStart) names the child, so the parent records subagent_start and subagent_stop events and the child's meta.json is linked to the parent. The link to the parent's task tool_call is set only when exactly one task call is pending. Sessions captured before these hooks were registered stay unlinked; re-run agent-strace setup --cli copilot or update the plugin to register them.
agentStop carries a stop reason and transcript path but no response text, so stop events have empty text.
Hook payloads carry no model name or token usage.
Tool hooks carry no call id, so tool results are paired with calls by tool name.
A tool denied at the permission prompt leaves its tool_call without a result or error; the permissionRequest and notification hooks that report it are not registered.
File and command activity is visible only in tool arguments and results; no file_write events are recorded.
Stores written before agent-strace 0.97.0 have no meta.json for subagent sessions; run agent-strace backfill-meta --apply to make them visible.
